Model–implementation correspondence may be required at task completion even when intermediate commits legitimately disagree; rendered-page correctness requires an integrated execution that earlier source, build, and API checks cannot establish. Place each check at the earliest boundary where sufficient evidence is available.

alt: Two independent obligations use different boundaries on an illustrative sequence of three commits, build, deploy, and browser execution. An arrow from commit 3 points to model–implementation correspondence, validated at task completion. An arrow from browser execution points to rendered-page correctness, validated in an integrated execution. A bracket below the commits allows intermediate model disagreement. A separate bracket below build and deploy, excluding browser execution, states that earlier source, build, and API checks do not establish rendered-page correctness.
